title: Empty If branch
description:
Error-prone rule — an If immediately followed by Else / Else If / End If, i.e. a branch with no steps. Often a leftover or logic bug.

Based on the PMD rule EmptyControlStatement — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_java_codestyle.html#emptycontrolstatement
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: An empty If branch either does nothing (dead condition) or signals a forgotten body.
rule.remediation: Remove the empty condition or fill in the intended steps.
